result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, owes no early-termination penalty, and Licensor receives no convenience-termination right during the committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” goes beyond the playbook requirement and introduces an undefined partial-termination right, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Otherwise, the existing commercial terms are preserved and the drafting is generally professional.
